d:
A sleeper bus with a bed for two, a cable-car ride into the mountains of Sapa, and a railway running right through a neighbourhood in Hanoi. Vietnam has some seriously unforgettable travel experiences!
In this vlog, Anushia and I try Vietnam’s “Love Bus” and take you inside the sleeper-bus experience. Travelling together hits differently when your seat is a bed and the journey becomes part of the adventure!
